title: Why Is Melbourne Famous for Coffee? | Chatsifieds

facts.fact: The Chatsifieds lesson is described as one of 12 practical café-English collections.
facts.quote: Part of [Australian Café Culture Coffee English](https://www.chatsifieds.com/resources/australian-coffee-culture/collections/australian-cafe-culture.html) — one of 12 practical café-English collections.

facts.fact: The page states that historical sources describe coffee stalls and coffee palaces in Melbourne in the nineteenth century, before the modern espresso era.
facts.quote: Yes. Historical sources describe nineteenth-century coffee stalls and coffee palaces.

facts.fact: The page defines a Melbourne magic as a small milk coffee usually based on a double ristretto and textured milk.
facts.quote: A small milk coffee commonly associated with Melbourne, usually based on a double ristretto and textured milk.

facts.fact: The page says Italian food and cafe life became closely associated with the Melbourne neighbourhood of Carlton.
facts.quote: Neighbourhoods such as Carlton became closely associated with Italian food and cafe life.

facts.fact: The page says post-war European migration helped transform Melbourne cafe culture and espresso drinking.
facts.quote: then post-war European migration helped transform cafe culture and espresso drinking.
